**Step 1 — Scene:** Six vegetable sushi rolls, a bowl of mixed fresh fruit, a small cup of soy sauce, and water.

**Step 2 — Vessels:** Sushi plate approximately 23 cm across: area **415 cm²**. Fruit bowl approximately 19 cm across: area **283 cm²**. Sauce cup approximately 4 cm across: area **13 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** Sushi containing rice, seaweed, avocado, cucumber and carrot; mixed fruit including melon, watermelon, grapes, strawberry and pineapple; soy sauce. No visible added oil or fruit dressing.

**Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Sushi is treated as one composite food to avoid counting its filling twice.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Vegetable sushi, six pieces | 25% | 104 cm² × 2.2 cm = 229 ml | 0.9 | 206 g | 150 | 309 kcal |
| Mixed fresh fruit | 70% | 198 cm² × 1.8 cm = 356 ml | 0.6 | 214 g | 45 | 96 kcal |
| Soy sauce | 90% | 12 cm² × 0.8 cm = 10 ml | 1.0 | 10 g | 53 | 5 kcal |

Coverage totals are **25% of the sushi plate**, **70% of the fruit bowl**, and **90% of the sauce cup**, respectively. Water contributes no calories and is excluded from food weight.

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately 34 g per sushi piece and 214 g of fruit are plausible for the visible portions. Estimated total: **430 g of food and sauce, 410 kcal**.
